newsitem.title: USA: MIDWEST EXPRESS JULY LOAD FACTOR RISES.
newsitem.headline: MIDWEST EXPRESS JULY LOAD FACTOR RISES.

text.p: Midwest Express Holdings Inc said Monday the load factor for its Midwest Express Airlines rose to 67.9 percent in July from 66.7 percent in the same month a year ago.
July traffic increased 17.3 percent to 132.1 million revenue passenger miles, while available seat miles were up 15.2 percent to 194.4 million.
Midwest Express said demand remains strong. However, competitive pricing pressures in certain markets continue to impact yields, it said.

For the first seven months of the year, the load factor for Midwest Express Airlines fell to 63.9 percent from 64.9 percent in the same period last year. Traffic increased 13 percent to 807.6 million revenue passenger miles, and available seat miles rose 14.7 percent to 1.3 billion.

Midwest Express reported the July load factor for its Skyway Airlines carrier fell to 44.9 percent from 45.2 percent in the same month last year. July traffic declined 7.6 percent to 5.7 million revenue passenger miles, and available seat miles were off seven percent to 12.8 million.

For the first seven months of 1997, the load factor for Skyway fell to 43.3 percent from 44.8 percent last year. Traffic decreased five percent to 39.4 million revenue passenger miles, and available seat miles slipped 1.8 percent to 90.8 million.
Shares of Midwest Express were trading up 1/2 to 24-1/2.
